# Shield Assurance LLC

> Arizona independent insurance agency helping families and small business owners compare practical auto, home, and business coverage.

## Primary pages
- Home: https://www.shield-assurance.com/
- Services: https://www.shield-assurance.com/services/
- About: https://www.shield-assurance.com/about/
- Claims: https://www.shield-assurance.com/claims/
- Contact: https://www.shield-assurance.com/contact/
- Coverage Review Process: https://www.shield-assurance.com/coverage-review-process/

## Service focus
- Personal insurance: homeowners, auto, renters, landlord/rental property, umbrella
- Business insurance: general liability, commercial property, BOP, commercial auto, workers compensation, cyber liability

## What clients can expect
- Straightforward recommendations before renewal
- Mid-policy updates when risks change
- Fast certificate support for job sites
- Claims guidance with direct advisor communication

## Geography
- Arizona statewide
- Based in Tucson, Arizona
